env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A const map declaration is removed from its own const keyword, whatever
# stands between the keyword and the name, and its uses are cut at the
# tokens of the use: a block comment, a line comment, or a line break in
# any gap changes nothing. The module runs natively, ejects, and the
# ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 10 20 30$'
stdout '^2 2 1 40 1 2$'
stdout '^2 2 1$'
stdout '^3 7 2$'
stdout '^18$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constmapboundary

go 1.27

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

const Table = map[string]int{"x": 7, "y": 8}

-- m/main.lgo --

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/constmapboundary/lib"
)

const func mk() map[string]int { return map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2} }

const /*c*/ M1 /*c*/ = /*c*/ map[string]int{ /*c*/ "a" /*c*/ : /*c*/ 1 /*c*/ , "b": 2 /*c*/ } /*c*/

	M2 = map[string]int{"a": 10}

	M3 = map[string]int{"a": 20}
const
	M4 = map[string]int{"a": 30}
const M5 = mk( /*c*/ ) /*c*/
const M6 = mk /*c*/ ( /*c*/ ) /*c*/
const M7 = mk(
)

const (
	M8  = map[string]int{"a": 40} /*c*/
	M9  = mk( /*c*/ ) /*c*/ // line
	M10 = mk(
	)
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(M1["a"] ?? 0, M2["a"] ?? 0, M3["a"] ?? 0, M4["a"] ?? 0)
	fmt.Println(M5["b"] ?? 0, M6["b"] ?? 0, M7["a"] ?? 0, M8["a"] ?? 0, M9["a"] ?? 0, M10["b"] ?? 0)
	fmt.Println(len( /*c*/ M1 /*c*/ ), len /*c*/ (M5 /*c*/), len(
		M8,
	))
	n := 0
	for _ /*c*/, v /*c*/ := range /*c*/ M1 /*c*/ {
		n += v
	}
	fmt.Println(n, lib.Table["x"] ?? 0, len( /*c*/ lib.Table /*c*/ ))
	for _, v := range /*c*/ lib.Table /*c*/ {
		n += v
	}
	fmt.Println(n)
}
